title: Same rule for Mary and the Saints: respective hyperdulia and dulia
source_text: XLVIII. Porro secundum istam Puteani doctrinam, similiter dicendum est, imagines Virginis Mariae adorandas esse hyperdulia, non absoluta, sed respectiva: imaginibus vero sanctorum reliquorum deberi quoque duliam respectivam & non absolutam.
pass_a_gloss: Further, according to that doctrine of Puteanus, it is similarly to be said that the images of the Virgin Mary are to be adored with hyperdulia, not absolute, but respective: and to the images of the remaining saints respective dulia is also owed, and not absolute.
pass_b_english: On Puteanus's scheme: Marian images get respective hyperdulia; other saints' images get respective dulia—not the absolute grades.
